title: auth.signIn deprecated: use signInWithPassword / signInWithOtp
summary: The generic supabase-js auth.signIn() and supabase-py auth.sign_in() helpers were split into explicit methods: signInWithPassword and signInWithOtp. The old methods are deprecated and will be removed.
body: Callers using email/password must rename the call to signInWithPassword. The deterministic codemod renames the method; review OTP callers separately.
migration: JS: supabase.auth.signIn({ email, password }) -> supabase.auth.signInWithPassword({ email, password }). Python: supabase.auth.sign_in(email=..., password=...) -> supabase.auth.sign_in_with_password(...). Magic-link callers should use signInWithOtp / sign_in_with_otp instead.

title: Go query builder rejects unknown Select columns
summary: supabase-go now validates column names in Select at request build time: queries that previously fell back to '*' now return an error when a column does not exist.
body: Curated seed change demonstrating a Go behavior finding on chained query-builder calls.
migration: Verify the columns passed to client.From(table).Select(cols, ...) exist in the database schema; pass '*' explicitly to select all columns.
